Photo of the speedometer/odometer cluster showing mileage
Photo or copy of purchase receipt and vehicle particulars/registration papers with matching chassis/engine number
Video of the engine starting, running, and gear shifting, plus a brake test
Close-up daylight photos of frame, swingarm, wheel rims (rust check) and tire tread
Full left and right side profile photos in good light
response.reason: The single rear photo does not show any legible brand/model marking, so the Suzuki claim and the specific variant that would set the price bracket cannot be confirmed or even assigned a worst-case figure; a model/engine-size photo and basic condition proof (odometer, engine, papers) are needed before any price, even a worst-case one, can be set.
